QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Magic Refinement 1
QuestInfo.0: The #bTemple Keeper#k, in the #bTemple of Time#k, might know about the Fog of Oblivion. Go ask and find out.
QuestInfo.1: The Temple Keeper said the #bSorcerer#k in the Road to Oblivion, beyond the Gate of the Past, might be able to make the Fog of Oblivion. Go find the Sorcerer.
QuestInfo.2: The Sorcerer already had the Fog of Oblivion, but it wasn't enough to cover several towns.

1.0: Why did you look for me? Do you need some magic refinement?
1.1: Hm? You need Fog of Oblivion? Well, I do have it. How much do you need? I can share a bit, if you can help in my research...

yes.0: What? You need enough fog to cover several towns? Even I don't have enough to pull that off. Where are you using it? Do you have that many things to forget?

npc.0: You'll find the #bSorcerer#k on the #bRoad to Oblivion#k, beyond the Gate of the Past. As the name implies, he's quite familiar with oblivion, and should be able to give you what you need.
